title: Compilence frozen-VAR stationarity sufficiency check
asserted_expression: Freezing the semantic graph / VAR coefficients at a snapshot is sufficient by itself to make the VAR process stationary.
asserted_exact_value: constant VAR coefficient implies time-invariant second moment
does_not_establish: This is a scalar VAR(1)/AR(1) counterexample with fixed coefficient a=2, x0=0, and iid unit-variance innovations. It shows that frozen coefficients alone do not imply covariance stationarity. It does not assess whether Compilence additionally enforces a spectral-radius stability condition in non-public material.
source_basis: Public research page states that the governance pipeline produces a frozen semantic graph at each snapshot in which the VAR(p) process is stationary by construction.
